name: karmageddon
description: Karmageddon, a life simulation game in front of the Stochia engine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bff,game -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @karmageddon/bff" "npm run dev -w @karmageddon/game"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @karmageddon/contract && npm run build -w @karmageddon/engine
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check -w @karmageddon/engine && npm run check -w @karmageddon/bff && npm run check -w @karmageddon/game
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @karmageddon/engine && npm run test -w @karmageddon/bff && npm run test -w @karmageddon/game
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @karmageddon/bff && npm run build -w @karmageddon/game
scripts.cards:validate: npm run build:packages && npm run cards:validate -w @karmageddon/bff
scripts.cards:simulate: npm run build:packages && npm run cards:simulate -w @karmageddon/bff --
